title: A strategy they can't beat even if they know it
hook: There's a way to play that can't be beaten, even if your opponent knows exactly what you're doing.
caption:
GTO: a strategy that can't be exploited even when your opponent knows it. Betting {bet} into {pot}: bluff {over} and they profit {call_ev_over} per call; bluff {under} and they fold; at {gto_bluff} there's nothing to exploit.

Educational content about decision theory and probability. We do not encourage gambling.

scenes.say: There's a way to play that can't be beaten, even if your opponent knows exactly what you're doing.
scenes.show: Unbeatable — even if they know it.

scenes.say: It's called game theory optimal: GTO.
You bet {bet} into {pot}. Bluff {over} of the time, and they call everything and profit {call_ev_over}.
scenes.note: Computed: caller's EV per call against your bluff share

scenes.say: At {gto_bluff}, they have nothing left to exploit.
GTO doesn't crush bad players hardest. It makes sure good players can't crush you.

takeaway: GTO doesn't crush bad players hardest. It makes sure good players can't crush you.
